note: Non-secret hosting configuration for the shared-field module. Credentials never live here: the SpaceTimeDB CLI keeps its login in ~/.config/spacetime/cli.toml and the SDK owner token is persisted under ${OI_STATE_HOME:-~/.local/state/oi}/spacetimedb/<database>.owner-token.

site_variables.OI_SPACETIMEDB_URI: repository variable → VITE_OI_SPACETIMEDB_URI at site build
site_variables.OI_SPACETIMEDB_DATABASE: repository variable → VITE_OI_SPACETIMEDB_DATABASE at site build
